claims: The in-market territory for Seattle Mariners games in the 2026 season includes WA, OR, ID, MT, AK.
Mariners.TV is a new streaming service costing $19.99 per month.
Mariners.TV is the primary direct-to-consumer streaming service for in-market Seattle Mariners games.
Mariners.TV is available on web or the MLB App without blackouts.
Xfinity/Comcast channel 1261 carries Seattle Mariners games.
DIRECTV channel 687 carries Seattle Mariners games.
FuboTV includes the local broadcast network.
Charter/Spectrum channels 318 or 414 carry Seattle Mariners games in Spokane.
Charter/Spectrum channel 130 carries Seattle Mariners games in Montana.
Charter/Spectrum channel 414 carries Seattle Mariners games in Seattle-Tacoma/Yakima/OR.
Astound/Wave channels for Seattle Mariners games vary by location, e.g., 37/737 in Seattle.
Fans outside the Pacific Northwest can stream all Seattle Mariners games via MLB.TV.
